Bot Backup & Restore

Export all bot data as a JSON file, or restore from a previous backup.

Admin Token
From the bot admin panel → Web Token, or the link from the bot.

Downloads all bot tables (settings, users, panels, products, orders, inventory, etc.) as a single JSON file. Each table is fetched individually to avoid timeouts — safe on Vercel Hobby or Pro.
